title: Reconcile the GSE Rating brand to a single composite doctrine (decision card)
summary: Resolve doc-10 Open Decision #1: pick whether the GSE Rating brand maps to the deploy-clone per-pick confidence (scoring.ts) or the canonical per-player processGrade (player-model.ts), and record the unified composite doctrine (hierarchical, percentile-normalized, calibration-gated). Produces a written ADR; touches no recipe constants. Productizing the player Rating in deploy is a PORT, not a flag flip — call that out.
acceptance: An ADR file states which artifact is the GSE Rating brand, names the composite doctrine (category tree -> sub-scores -> categories -> 0-100), and flags the canonical->deploy port as a prerequisite for the player Rating. No source/constants changed; typecheck unaffected.

title: Define the hierarchical category tree + per-category weight constants (internal, shadow weight 0)
summary: Encode doc-10 §3.1 seven categories (Market 28 / Production 14 / Efficiency 16 / NextGen 10 / Trenches 10 / Availability 8 / Environment 8 / Signal 6) as INTERNAL weight constants alongside the existing WEIGHTS, with every non-Market category entering at effective weight 0 (shadow). Additive change: extends the existing shadow pattern (process-sport.ts:70-96), does not alter the live confidence sum. Weights never leave the server (reveal-less).
acceptance: New internal CATEGORY_WEIGHTS constant sums to 100; a unit test asserts the live confidence output is byte-identical before/after (all non-Market categories contribute 0). No weight value is importable by any apps/web client module; method-leakage-gate test still passes.

title: Build the roll-up pipeline scaffold: impute -> normalize(percentile) -> de-correlate -> sub-score
summary: Implement doc-10 §4.1 steps 1-4 as pure functions producing per-category sub-scores in [0,1]: drop-missing imputation (never null->0), within-peer-pool percentile normalization, correlation-pruning of within-category inputs into one sub-score. Runs in SHADOW only (logged, not blended). Net-new vs the flat additive sum in scoring.ts:340-348.
acceptance: Pure functions are deterministic and unit-tested: a missing input drops from its sub-score (no 0 coercion), percentile is monotone and outlier-robust, correlated inputs collapse to one sub-score. Live confidence path unchanged; sub-scores are computed and logged but not added to the published number.

title: Add geometric-leaning weighted aggregation + monotone undisclosed 0-100 map (shadow)
summary: Implement doc-10 §4.1 steps 6-7: combine category sub-scores with the §3.1 weights using geometric-leaning aggregation (so one spiked category can't fake Elite), then a monotone, internal-only map to 0-100 = the shadow GSE Rating composite. Shadow-only; the public Edge Index continues to read the existing confidence. Reveal-less by construction (percentile inputs + hierarchical sub-scores + undisclosed map).
acceptance: Aggregation is monotone in each sub-score and penalizes imbalance vs pure additive (test: a single maxed category yields a lower composite than balanced sub-scores summing the same). The 0-100 map and the aggregation fn are not exported to any client bundle. Published Edge Index value is unchanged.

title: Fix the canonical null->0 percentile coercion bug (drop-missing before ranking)
summary: Doc-10 §4.4 grounded bug: canonical player-model.ts:167-169 coerces missing DAKOTA/PACR to 0 before percentile ranking, deflating the pool and inflating percentiles of QBs who have the metric. Change to drop-missing (as the model's own docstring promises). Canonical-clone fix; deploy clone benefits via the RAT-03 imputation rule already enforced.
acceptance: A unit test with a pool where some players lack DAKOTA/PACR shows missing values are excluded from the percentile denominator (not treated as 0); no borderline QB's percentile rises purely because peers are missing the metric. Existing tests green.

title: Add empirical-Bayes / James-Stein shrinkage at the scoring layer (step 5)
summary: Implement doc-10 §4.3: regress a thin-sample sub-score toward its population prior until evidence accumulates, so the top tier requires BOTH a high point estimate AND sufficient n. Generalizes the existing publish-layer gates (MIN_BUCKET_SAMPLE=30, MIN_CANONICAL_DEFAULT=25) down into scoring. Shadow-only; no published number moves.
acceptance: Test: an entity with n below threshold is pulled measurably toward the prior; as n grows the shrunk estimate converges to the raw sub-score. Shrinkage runs before aggregation in the shadow path only. No client export of priors/thresholds.

title: Add an absolute anchor floor to the Elite band (relative percentile can't mint false Elite)
summary: Implement doc-10 §4.3 + §6.3: the Elite band requires the percentile rank AND a fixed absolute bar (e.g. an EPA/CPOE/efficiency floor) so a down year for a position can't auto-populate Elite. Recipe-surface change -> founder-gated; build the gated form (anchor constants internal, behind a config that defaults to the current behavior until a MODEL_VERSION bump). Reveal-less: the floor values never ship to a client.
acceptance: Test: a player at >=85 percentile but below the absolute anchor is NOT labeled Elite when the anchor is enabled; with the anchor disabled (default) behavior is unchanged. Anchor constants are server-only. Enabling the anchor is documented as requiring a founder MODEL_VERSION bump.

title: Per-position weight vectors as internal constants (QB/WR/TE/RB/OL/team)
summary: Implement doc-10 §4.5: the same seven categories re-weighted per role (QB->Efficiency-heavy, WR/TE->NextGen-heavy, RB->Production+Trenches, OL->Trenches-dominant, team/game->Market+Environment+Efficiency). Internal constants like the existing ANCHORS.QB; never published. Shadow-only application.
acceptance: Per-position weight maps each sum to 100 and select the documented heaviest categories per position; a test asserts position selects the correct vector. Vectors not exported to any client bundle; method-leakage test passes.

title: Bounded per-matchup adjustment delta (tilts, never overturns)
summary: Implement doc-10 §4.6: after the base composite, apply a capped matchup delta where a subject's category sub-scores are nudged by the opponent's complementary sub-scores (WR NextGen vs opposing coverage; pass-rush Trenches vs opposing protection). Delta capped (internal +/-X) so matchup tilts but never flips the base read, preserving calibration. Shadow-only.
acceptance: Test: the adjusted composite never moves more than the configured cap from the base composite; a strong opponent reduces the relevant sub-score within bounds. Cap constant is server-only. Published number unchanged (shadow).

title: Capture a ClosingLine snapshot per pick (alongside existing OpeningLine)
summary: Doc-10 §5.3 grounded gap: CLV does not exist anywhere in the deploy clone (only OpeningLine). Add a ClosingLine snapshot model/field captured per pick at close, sourced through the existing licensed odds adapter with provenance + freshness + blocked-source handling. Data-capture only; depends on R&D BUILD-032 for provider license flags (DEDUPE: this card adds the snapshot wiring, BUILD-032 adds the provider-flag plumbing — keep BUILD-032 as the upstream license gate, do not re-implement provider flags here).
acceptance: A ClosingLine row is recorded per settled pick with source + capture timestamp; missing/blocked close degrades gracefully (no fake value). Migration is additive (new model/columns, no destructive change). Adapter has a mocked-response test.

title: Compute per-pick CLV + the CLV scoreboard (engine's true scoreboard)
summary: Doc-10 §5.3: compute per-pick CLV (bet-time price vs ClosingLine) and a rolling CLV-positive rate, with the documented target (>60-65% over 200+ wagers signals genuine edge). Internal scoreboard that de-noises results before W/L variance resolves. Net-new computation layer on top of WIN-01 (BUILD-032 captures lines; this computes the value).
acceptance: Per-pick CLV is computed only when both bet-time and closing prices exist; rolling CLV-positive rate matches a hand-computed fixture; the scoreboard is internal/ops-only by default. No recipe weights exposed.

title: Add at least one truly independent probability estimator (break the circular edge)
summary: Doc-10 §5.4 grounded flaw: today's edge de-vigs the book's own consensus (scoring.ts:271-278) so 'edge vs market' is circular; trueEvScore/fairProbability are hardcoded null (scoring.ts:392-393). Produce an independent fairProbability from the activated Efficiency/NextGen/Trenches sub-scores (ideally a stacked ensemble) so the model has something orthogonal to the line. Shadow-only; measured by CLV (WIN-02), never auto-blended.
acceptance: fairProbability is produced from non-market sub-scores (no longer null) and is provably not derived from the consensus de-vig (test asserts independence from the consensus input); it is logged in shadow and not added to the published confidence. CLV scoreboard can ingest it.

title: Publish the reliability curve as the public trust artifact (results, not method)
summary: Doc-10 §5.5 + §6.2: surface the already-computed Brier + per-bucket observed-vs-expected reliability curve (calibration/compute.ts:84-148) on the public performance surface as the honesty proof — gated on the existing >=25-canonical-sample policy (public-performance-policy.ts:47). Reveals method nothing; proves the number means what it says. Additive UI/read; no recipe exposure.
acceptance: The performance page renders the reliability curve + Brier only when the sample policy is met (bootstrap excluded); below threshold it shows the honest empty/early-state copy. A method-leakage test confirms no weight/constant/category-name leaks into the rendered output.

title: Train/penalize toward calibration with log loss + held-out isotonic/Platt (evidence-only)
summary: Doc-10 §5.5: use log loss (punishes confident-wrong hardest) and post-hoc isotonic/Platt on a held-out split to improve calibration, producing evidence only. MUST NOT auto-apply: canApplyCalibrationAdjustments stays hardcoded false (readiness.ts:100,124); a human MODEL_VERSION bump is the only path to apply. Build the gated form: compute + store the proposed adjustment, never apply it.
acceptance: The calibration job emits a proposed isotonic/Platt mapping + log-loss delta as a stored proposal; a test asserts canApplyCalibrationAdjustments is still false and no live weight changes. Applying remains a founder MODEL_VERSION action.

title: Reconcile the grade ladders: keep two-input computePickGrade, deprecate divergent single-input table
summary: Doc-10 §6.3 grounded inconsistency: three ladders coexist (PickTier FREE/PREMIUM paywall; two-input computePickGrade(confidence,edgeScore) at types/src/index.ts:106-114; a divergent single-input gradeForConfidence at brand/src/grades.ts). Make computePickGrade the single quality source of truth (Elite/Strong/Solid/Lean), deprecate the brand/src/grades.ts table, and keep FREE/PREMIUM paywall as a SEPARATE orthogonal axis. Touches the recipe surface -> founder-gated.
acceptance: All grade reads route through computePickGrade; the divergent single-input table is removed or marked deprecated with no remaining importers; paywall (conf>=70) is computed on a separate code path from quality. Tests assert quality tier and paywall tier are decoupled; typecheck/lint green.

title: Player Rating public band names + relative-rank annotation
summary: Doc-10 §6.3: map player composite to public bands Elite>=85 / High 70-84 / Solid 55-69 / Watch 40-54 / Risk <40 (canonical colors.ts:27-33), WITH the §4.3 absolute Elite floor (RAT-07) and a 'graded vs position, this season' annotation so a percentile never reads as an absolute claim. Reveal-less: band thresholds shown, recipe not.
acceptance: Player band label renders with the relative-rank annotation; Elite requires the absolute floor when enabled. A test asserts the annotation is present on any percentile-derived band and that no weight/recipe text is rendered.

title: Write real GateDecision rows + partition slate by quality tier (lead with Elite/Strong)
summary: Doc-10 §8 grounded gap: GateDecision is READ by the board (board/state.ts:144) but NEVER written by production (no gateDecision.create/upsert). Write real GateDecision rows (status + reasonCode) so GATED/PUBLISHED lanes light up and 'no Strong play today' becomes an auditable record; partition the published slate by the §6.3 quality tier and lead with Elite/Strong. Keep the conf<50 / consensus<0.55 floor as a DATA-SUFFICIENCY filter, explicitly not a sub-70% win-rate refusal. Additive (new writes + ordering).
acceptance: Production writes a GateDecision row per evaluated pick with a reasonCode; the board's GATED/PUBLISHED lanes populate from real rows; the slate is ordered Elite->Strong->Solid->Lean; the empty-state banner ('no Strong play today, here are the leans') sits beside the existing honest copy. The data-sufficiency floor is documented as not a win-rate filter.

title: Extend the reveal-less method-leakage gate to the new composite vocabulary
summary: Doc-10 §2/§6: the new category names, per-category weights, aggregation function, shrinkage priors, anchor floors, per-position vectors, matchup cap, and the very existence of the Signal/SiriusXM lane must NEVER reach a public bundle. Extend the existing method-leakage gate (method-leakage-gate.test.ts) and trust-claims INTERNAL_VOCABULARY to fail the build if any new internal term/constant appears in a client bundle or public DTO.
acceptance: The gate test fails if any of the new internal vocabulary (category weights, aggregation/shrinkage/anchor terms, 'siriusxm'/'airwave'/'ch 87' as recipe components) appears in built client assets or a public DTO; passes on the current tree. Runs in CI as a hard gate.

title: FREE/PRO/ELITE value gradient = depth on the same number, never method
summary: Doc-10 §7: encode the gradient as more RESOLUTION on the same truthful number (FREE: number+tier+read+reliability headline; PRO: raw confidence, per-category bars WITHOUT weights, line movement; ELITE: CLV trend + alerts), with method opacity identical at every tier. Grounded in existing entitlements (types/src/index.ts:88-100). Additive entitlement wiring; the Signal layer existence/weights stay NEVER at all tiers.
acceptance: Entitlement flags render per-category bars (values, no weights) at PRO+, CLV trend + alerts at ELITE, and the reliability headline at FREE; a test asserts no tier (including ELITE) exposes weights, aggregation, or Signal-lane existence. method-leakage gate (RLS-01) passes.

title: Port the Airwave module from canonical into the deploy clone (inert, gated-off)
summary: Doc-12 §3.7 + doc-10 §1: Airwave does not exist in the deploy clone (zero grep hits) — it is canonical-only. Port lib/airwave/* (types, grade, redact, pipeline, control-plane), the /cockpit/airwave route, and the demo-ledger of FICTIONAL personas, all INERT behind AIRWAVE_ENABLED (default-off). No capture, no real names, no Rating wiring. Preserves doctrine verbatim: paraphrase-only, no audio archive, redact.ts strips sourceClipRef from every public DTO.
acceptance: With AIRWAVE_ENABLED unset, captureGate holds every source and only the fictional demo ledger renders; redact.ts toPublicClaim is an explicit field copy (clip-pointer leak is a compile error); no real person is named anywhere public; typecheck/lint green. No Rating consumes Airwave.

title: Add the AIRWAVE_RATING_INPUT_ENABLED third gate (shadow-only by default)
summary: Doc-12 §3.2: add the PROPOSED third gate stacked on AIRWAVE_ENABLED + AIRWAVE_SIRIUSXM_LEGAL_ACK that governs whether the graded SiriusXM lane may blend into the Rating at all. Default-off -> the lane runs shadow-only (logged, not blended). Build the gate plumbing only; flipping it on is a separate founder MODEL_VERSION action. No live blend.
acceptance: A new default-off flag exists; with it unset the SiriusXM lane is computed/logged but contributes 0 to any Rating; control-plane policy still hard-codes autoPublishes:false / archivesRawAudio:false. A test asserts the published number is unchanged while the flag is off.

title: Define the SiriusXM Ch 87 show catalog + provisional L1 sub-weights (config, re-verify-at-launch)
summary: Doc-12 Part 1 + Part 2.2: encode the web-verified Ch 87 lineup (FF Morning, Elite Sports/Mans, RotoWire Fantasy Sports Today, Fantasy Footballers Thu live, FTN, Fantasy Alarm, Fantasy Life, etc.) with per-show confidence + the provisional L1 relative shares (FF Morning 18%, Elite 14%, RotoWire 12%, Footballers 12%, ...). EXCLUDE 'Establish the Run' (not verified on 87). Carry the slot-confidence caveats; mark FTN slot unconfirmed. Internal config; shares are a shadow-mode prior, re-derived from realized accountability.
acceptance: The catalog lists only web-verified shows with source + confidence fields, excludes Establish the Run, marks FTN slot unconfirmed, and the L1 shares sum to ~100% with a reserve. A test asserts shares sum and that no show is listed without a confidence tier. Catalog is server-only (reveal-less).

title: Schedule-bounded Ch 87 capture pointer (gated, legal-gated, no audio archive)
summary: Doc-12 §3.3 step 1: point the existing schedule-bounded capture at Ch 87 live windows, rolling ~10-min segments to a temp store DELETED after extraction. Held entirely unless AIRWAVE_ENABLED AND AIRWAVE_SIRIUSXM_LEGAL_ACK are both set; satellite-radio capture is LEGAL-GATED (media-attorney sign-off on source terms/copyright/right-of-publicity). Recommended path: prove on free YouTube/podcast feeds FIRST; satellite goes last. Build the gated form only — capture stays inert.
acceptance: With either gate off, planCapture is a dry-run that NEVER captures and captureGate holds Ch 87; no audio is persisted (temp-only, deleted post-extraction). The legal checklist (source terms, copyright, right-of-publicity, paraphrase-only) is referenced and unchecked. A test asserts zero capture while gated.

title: Transcribe -> extract -> grade paraphrased PunditClaims (paraphrase-by-contract)
summary: Doc-12 §3.3 steps 2-4: Whisper-class transcription + diarization -> structured PunditClaim rows (subject entity, claim type start-sit/ADP/usage/injury/betting-structure, emphasis EMPHATIC/LEAN/HEDGED, show+host, internal-only timestamp + sourceClipRef), assertions PARAPHRASED never verbatim (redact.ts), graded HIT/MISS/PUSH/UNFALSIFIABLE via grade.ts (EMPHATIC 1.5/LEAN 1.0/HEDGED 0.6; UNFALSIFIABLE non-recoverable 0.5). Operator review in /cockpit/airwave before anything public. Runs only when SXM-04 gates are open; otherwise the demo ledger only.
acceptance: A fixture transcript yields paraphrased PunditClaim rows (no verbatim quote leaves the private store), graded deterministically by grade.ts; UNFALSIFIABLE posts 0.5 and contributes nothing; sourceClipRef is stripped from every public DTO. Operator-review draft state blocks auto-publish.

title: Shadow-log the bounded per-entity broadcast lean (accountability-weighted, NOT blended)
summary: Doc-12 §3.3 step 6 + §3.4: derive the per-entity broadcast signal = that lane's settled, falsifiable claims weighted by each pundit's accountabilityIndex and confidence, decayed by claim age, into a small bounded directional lean + confidence. Log it next to the pick; DO NOT blend. A low-index host's emphatic call decays toward 0 automatically. Measures realized contribution against settled outcomes. Net-new shadow lane; no published number moves.
acceptance: Per-entity lean is computed from SETTLED claims only, accountability-weighted and age-decayed, bounded to the L1 budget; a test shows a low-index pundit contributes ~0 and the published Rating is unchanged (shadow). UNFALSIFIABLE/pending claims excluded.

title: Gated blend of the SiriusXM lane into the Rating (low-ceiling, founder + MODEL_VERSION)
summary: Doc-12 §3.3 step 7 + doc-10 §3.2: ONLY when AIRWAVE_RATING_INPUT_ENABLED is set does the shadow lane become a live, low-ceiling additive estimator capped at the bounded L1 budget (Signal category cap 6; SiriusXM sub-weight 3). Turning shadow->live is a founder decision that ALSO requires a MODEL_VERSION bump. This card FLIPS A LIVE SWITCH -> build the gated form only: wire the consumer, leave the flag off, document the founder go-live. Never overrides market structure.
acceptance: With the flag off (default) the blend contributes 0 and the published number is identical to pre-card; with the flag on in a test harness the lane adds at most the Signal/SiriusXM cap and cannot flip a pick. A test asserts the cap and that market structure is never overridden. Go-live documented as founder + MODEL_VERSION.

title: Beat-report lane as an independent estimator (manual-review, distinct from SiriusXM)
summary: Doc-12 §2.0 L2 + doc-10 §3.2: model the beat-reporter-mesh lane (licensed, manual-review) as its OWN estimator — fastest factual status (practice participation, snaps, role/usage, designations) — structurally separate from the SiriusXM lane, with its own rights status, reliability tier, and Signal sub-weight (2 of 6). DEDUPE: R&D BUILD-099 (beat-writer reliability tracker) covers source-reliability scoring without copying protected text — reuse it as the reliability input; this card adds the Rating-estimator wiring + sub-weight, not a second reliability tracker. Shadow-first.
acceptance: The beat lane produces an independent per-entity factual-status signal kept separate from the SiriusXM lane (no blended-at-ingest number); it consumes BUILD-099 reliability without duplicating it; runs shadow-only and moves no published number. A test asserts lane independence and zero published-number change.

title: Web/Reddit crowd-aggregate adapter (net-new lowest-trust lane, smallest sub-weight)
summary: Doc-12 §2.0 L3 + doc-10 §3.2: build the net-new crowd-aggregate adapter (does not exist in either clone — 'no social sentiment score is live'). Directional crowd-sentiment lean, lowest trust, smallest Signal sub-weight (1 of 6), from APPROVED public sources only (no scraping of disallowed surfaces; honor source registry). Kept structurally separate from SiriusXM + beat lanes; enters the Rating as an independent low-ceiling estimator. Shadow-first; behind the same gate stack.
acceptance: The crowd lane produces a bounded directional lean from approved sources only, capped at the smallest Signal sub-weight, kept separate from the other two lanes; a test asserts the source allow-list is enforced and the published number is unchanged (shadow). No disallowed-surface scraping.

title: Three-lane Signal composite under the Signal category cap (independent estimators, never collapsed at ingest)
summary: Doc-12 §2.0 hard rule + doc-10 §3.2: combine the three Signal lanes (SiriusXM 3 / beat 2 / crowd 1, summing to the Signal cap of 6) as INDEPENDENT estimators that never collapse into one blended number at ingest — each keeps its own rights status, reliability tier, and weight, and the Signal category is capped at 6/100 so it breaks ties and flags what the numbers miss but never dominates. Shadow-first; live only via SXM-07-class founder + MODEL_VERSION gates per lane.
acceptance: The Signal composite sums the three lane sub-weights to exactly the category cap (6), preserves per-lane independence (a test shows each lane's rights/reliability tier is retained, not merged), and the total Signal contribution never exceeds 6/100 nor overrides a quantitative read. Shadow by default; no published number moves until per-lane founder gates open.

title: Temporal out-of-sample validation harness (walk-forward CV + frozen-season holdout + disjoint calibration split)
summary: Doc-11 §5 (critic fix F-9, the one genuinely net-new card): add an internal validation harness that prevents future-info leakage when judging the engine's realized rate — walk-forward cross-validation over chronological folds, a frozen-season holdout never used in fitting, and a rule that any isotonic/Platt calibration (PRF-02) is fit on a DISJOINT split from the data it scores. Reports out-of-sample hit rate + CLV + reliability with sample-size honesty; never fabricates or extrapolates a rate. Safe/additive: a test+ops harness over already-settled picks; moves no published number. PRF-02 and WIN-03 should consume this split discipline rather than fitting in-sample.
acceptance: The harness produces chronological walk-forward folds and a frozen holdout from settled picks, and a test fails if any calibration mapping is fit on data overlapping its scoring set; it reports out-of-sample hit rate/CLV/Brier with the existing sample-size policy applied. No live weight or published number changes; runs in CI/ops only.
